hazards.hazard: Working at height for display installation (high level mount)
controls: Class 1 stepladders EN131 rated only; 3-point contact maintained.
Working area cordoned; no personnel permitted below drop zone.

hazards.hazard: Manual handling of large-format displays (58 kg)
controls: Team lift (2 engineers minimum) for any item over 20 kg.
Screen trolley used from vehicle to install location.
Correct lifting technique briefed at toolbox talk.
Isolation permit obtained before rack power-on.
Test-before-touch on every circuit prior to termination.

hazards.hazard: Asbestos-Containing Materials (ACMs) risk during any ceiling tile disturbance
controls: No works to proceed above ceiling tiles until the asbestos register entry for this area is confirmed.
Stop work and report to site management if suspect material is disturbed.

phases.title: Site Set-Up and Delivery
steps: Sign in at reception; complete site induction with facilities team.
Position vehicles per client's delivery-zone plan; deploy dust sheets.
Establish welfare and rest area; agree comms channel with site contact.

phases.title: First Fix — Cable Pulls and Bracket Installation
steps: Confirm receipt of the client's asbestos register before any ceiling tile work begins.
Pull power and structured cabling to each device location.
Install VESA brackets to walls (verify wall construction; use reinforcement plate if plasterboard).

phases.title: Second Fix — Display and Rack Installation
steps: Terminate structured cabling; label per site cable-schedule.
Install AV rack; power-on with electrical isolation permit.

phases.title: Commissioning and Handover
steps: Configure Biamp DSP; upload Crestron control code.
Walk client contact through system operation; sign off Section 8.

tools_and_equipment: Insulated hand tools (screwdrivers, pliers, wire strippers)
Cordless drill 18V with masonry + wood bits
Laptop for DSP configuration and device testing
client_responsibilities: Mains power outlets live at each equipment location.
Network drops (Cat6) active and PoE-enabled where applicable.
Training room booked out and empty on installation days.
Client IT contact available for VLAN cutover.
Site contact available throughout the working day.
Client to provide the current asbestos register for the building prior to any ceiling access.
